prompt_instructions: Attach the original image to preserve decor balance, rail placement, and exact garment arrangement.
Keep visible text exactly as 'BADASS', 'STRIPED POLO', and 'POKTK740'.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square premium interior display poster for a striped BADASS polo collection. Use a modern interior setup with a dark cabinet on the left, framed minimalist art, stacked decor books, and a background split between dark vertical slats and a pale gray panel. On the right, hang two striped polos from wooden hangers on a curved silver rail. Add a white BADASS wordmark at the top right, large title text 'STRIPED POLO' above the garments, and small white product code 'POKTK740' at the lower left. Technical style: photorealistic interior product display poster, soft directional interior light, upscale showroom ambiance, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
